verdict.description: Binary decision. The gate layer maps verdict+confidence to {skip-gpt5, advance-flagged, advance}.

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence. >=0.80 + verdict=skip => skip-gpt5. <0.80 OR verdict=advance => advance-flagged.

reason.description: One-sentence rubric-criterion citation; plain English; no personal data.

title_delta.description: Optional. Brief description of how the new title differs from prior (e.g. 'identical', 'qualifier-only', 'team-suffix-added').

freshness_signal.description: Optional. Whether the gate should treat the new posting as fresh signal even on advance verdicts.
